## WF1 — Outreach engine
Calls Google Gemini (free tier). Anthropic was the original plan, but a billing block on the Anthropic key mid-build forced a pivot to Gemini — marked a permanent decision on 2026-07-09. Full reasoning in the case study README.

Credentials:
1. Supabase (host + service_role key)
2. Gemini: Header Auth credential → Name: `x-goog-api-key` · Value: your API key from aistudio.google.com
